items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Judge wasn't in that band then. He wasn't in the band with us then.

ctx.x: You didn't have Judge Gaynor in that band?

No, Judge wasn't in that band then. He wasn't in the band with us then. Judge, uh, Judge, uh, he didn't stay in New Orleans that much. He'd mostly be in and out, he'd mostly be here in New York City. He's a good banjo player.
He traveled up to Mississippi for a while, with little brother Montgomery and another group.
